about: What scripts/store-push.sh needs beside the copy (store-presence-and-support-pages.md §2, docs/how-to/store-listings.md). `ios.screenshots`: the screens the App Store listing shows, in order, taken from screenshots.manifest.json by sha256 — never the support pages' whole set. `languages`: store locale → the manifest's language segment. `framed`: false takes the plain captures (<device>), true the framed renders (<device>framed, scripts/store-frame). ⚠ 05-workouts is iPhone only (Fit cannot seed on the iPad, store-screenshots.md §3e/§3g), so the iPad set has one screen fewer.
